notes.title: Work on new phobia "Phasmophobia"
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We're excited to announce that we're working on a global update for the game, and very soon we'll be ready to show you a new phobia and a series of improvements in the game!
The new phobia related to ghosts will be available to all players very soon!
We're grateful to all players for their feedback! Stay with us for collaborative efforts to enhance the gaming experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44718638/a4b1034341e941e9206a498cf87358c2f2bbe0dd.png[/img]

notes.title: New phobia: Phasmophobia will be available soon!
notes.content:
Development has begun on the new phobia, 'Phasmophobia.' Soon, Phasmophobia will be available to all players. We'd like to share with you some brief aspects of the development.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44718638/114babd1d7f895aacd3677a06f4e3d22b929cc28.png[/img]
[olist]
[*] Unique plot and characters.
[*] New 3D location.
[*] New sound system for surround sound.
[*] Creepy atmosphere and intriguing puzzles.
[*] Interaction with enemies.
[/olist]

Stay tuned for updates and actively participate in the development!
